title: LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy Installment Service Charge — Billing Desk Reference
content:
Each billed installment of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy term other than installment 1 carries one installment fee, and a billed installment found without it is charged the fee on the day it is found. No installment fee is charged on a mortgagee-billed term or on a tier whose installment service charge is 0.00.

## Which installments carry the fee

| Billed installment | Installment fee |
|---|---|
| installment 1 of a term | none |
| installment 2, 3 or 4 of a term billed to the insured, on a tier with a charge above 0.00 | one fee |
| any installment of a mortgagee-billed term | none |
| any installment on a tier whose charge is 0.00 | none |

The fee is recorded against the term and the position of the installment it belongs to.

## Situation of use and capability

`assess_installment_fee_8325e06b` charges the installment service fee for one billed installment of a LandlordGuard dwelling policy. One call posts one installment-fee entry on the policy's premium account for the named term and installment and raises the premium balance by the fee; the fee then shows on the premium account.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `assess_installment_fee_8325e06b`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | the reference id of the landlord dwelling policy record, as returned by the dwelling policy lookup for the verified caller | identifier |
| `term_effective_date` | the start date of the policy term the installment belongs to, as on the billed installment | YYYY-MM-DD; never empty |
| `installment_number` | the position of the billed installment within its term, as shown on the billed installment (1 is the opening installment) | integer 0 to 4 |
| `amount` | the fee in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places when posted |

## Return

A one-line receipt: "Installment fee posted: entry <entry_id> on policy <dwelling_policy_id>, term <term_effective_date> installment <installment_number>, <amount> USD on <posted_date>." The entry id is the new premium-ledger entry; the term date and posted date are YYYY-MM-DD, the installment number is the integer position and the amount is shown to 2 decimal places. Receiving this line means the fee is posted.
